# API reference

- [HTTP API](http.md): the `/auth` routes, bodies, responses, errors, CSRF
  and cookies.
- [Server API](server.md): `createAuth`, route guards, policies and the
  exports of the generated `auth/` module.
- [Client API](client.md): the generated frontend client and its Vue and
  React layers.
- CLI: `packages/cli/README.md` (in the SelfAuth repository), or
  `selfauth <command> --help`.
- Packages: `@selfauth/spec` (`packages/spec/README.md` in the SelfAuth repository),
  `@selfauth/migration` (`packages/migration/README.md` in the SelfAuth repository) and
  `@selfauth/conformance` (`conformance/README.md` in the SelfAuth repository). These are
  development tools; generated apps don't import them.
